name: T10 Calling Smartwatch
subtitle: Large display with Bluetooth wrist calling
description: T10 Bluetooth calling smartwatch has a 2.09-inch HD touch display for viewing calls, messages, notifications, and daily activity. Pair it with a compatible Android or iOS phone, use the action button for quick control, and recharge conveniently with the magnetic charger.
story: Designed for everyday wear, the T10 keeps common phone updates visible on a larger wrist display while Bluetooth calling adds a convenient way to handle calls when your phone is nearby. The touch interface and action button provide two ways to move through functions, and the orange fabric-style strap gives the watch a distinctive look. With activity tracking and up to five days of typical battery life, it suits routines that mix work, commuting, and casual exercise.
shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
